WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs

  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
)

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) IN ('byes', 'legbyes', 'penalty')
          THEN total_runs - extra_runs
        ELSE total_runs
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS economy
FROM bowler_stats
WHERE legal_balls >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      total_runs - CASE
        WHEN extras_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes') THEN extra_runs
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
          AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / wickets AS bowling_average
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE wickets >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  tmc.team,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(tw.wins, 0) / tmc.matches_played, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_match_counts tmc
LEFT JOIN team_wins tw ON tmc.team = tw.team
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, batter, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'LBW', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket')
GROUP BY bowler, batter
ORDER BY dismissals DESC
LIMIT 1
